title: Settings › Help & about shows the server build, the desktop app's update state with Later/Restart/automatic-check switch, What's new as plain text and links per language, over an IPC bridge only the product top frame may use
steps: S1: Run the update-state reducer, preferences store, updater (fake clock) and update bridge suites of packages/desktop/tracy-desktop.
S2: Run the Help & about render and model suite of packages/ui/tracy-settings.
S3: Run the GET /api/build door suite of apps/tracy-web.
expect: S1: a fresh updater is idle (never 'up to date'); Later keeps the version downloaded; a refusal after Restart is install-error, not a network error; release notes lose CR, control and bidi characters and HTML tags and are capped at 20000; the menu, page and timer share one check; switching automatic checks off cancels the start-up, 4-hour and backoff timers and a running check schedules nothing, on again gives exactly one early check, a save that fails changes nothing; the dmg address must stay on the feed origin; the bridge refuses a subframe, another window and another origin, takes only a boolean for the switch, coalesces a burst of checks and sends the listed DTO fields only.

S2: the web shows the honest update line and no switch; an app from before the bridge shows its version and asks for an update; each update state draws its line and only its buttons; What's new shows only for a waiting version with notes, as escaped text in a scrollable region; links follow the interface language and open a new tab with noopener noreferrer; Help & about sits last with a dot from a badge source the nav follows while another section is open, though dsh drops extra registration options; ?settings=help opens it.
S3: a signed-in person reads the full commit and build time with no-store; signed out is 401 NOT_SIGNED_IN; a missing or malformed value is null.
evidence: tasks/evidence/desktop-help-about/ (real Electron IPC guard 20/20, stand screenshots, packaged app 0.3.0-dev.900 → 901 29/29)
fence: Deterministic in-process suites: the update state machine, the switch and schedule on a fake clock, the IPC guard against stand-in frames, the section rendered to markup, the build door. The real Electron frames, the stand and the packaged app run are recorded once in the evidence folder; they need a display, a stand and self-signed signing.
